policy: Exact ordered vendor SVGchild markup copied into external defs/g fragments; root viewBox/attrs remain on outer SVG. No SVGO, path simplification, coordinate changes or individual-icon HTTP requests. Common is measured legal25; catalog is public home/menu/category usage; features is remaining public events/reservation/social-extra usage.
limitations: Generator evidence is not a production payload saving measurement or browser render/interaction pass. Combined-build initial JS and native SVG network transfer must be measured separately.
